rounds.response:
Admission orders (ready to sign):

1) Antibiotics: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hours IV; Azithromycin 500 mg IV once then 500 mg IV every 24 hours — for presumed community-acquired pneumonia; reassess in 48–72 hours and convert to oral therapy when clinically appropriate.  
2) PRN antipyretic: Acetaminophen 650 mg PO/PR every 4–6 hours as needed for fever >38.0°C (max 3 g/24 hr).  
3) Labs (one-time STAT): CBC with differential, BMP, LFTs, and serum lactate — obtain now.  
4) Supportive nursing: Continue O2 via nasal cannula at 3 L/min, titrate to SpO2 ≥92%; maintain IV access; routine vital signs q4h and PRN, notify team for SBP <90 mmHg, MAP <65 mmHg, HR >130, RR >30, or clinical deterioration.
